name: Kir Haraseth
overview: Kir Haraseth, also known as Kirhareseth, Kir-Haresh, and Kirheres, is identified in Scripture as a significant city of Moab, often referred to as the Kir of Moab. The prophetic passages in Isaiah and Jeremiah lament the destruction and mourning over this city, portraying it as a place stricken and brought to silence, evoking deep sorrow and lamentation for its downfall. These verses emphasize God's judgment on Moab and the sorrowful response to the loss of the city's riches and foundations, highlighting the seriousness of divine discipline upon this once-fortified city.
